decisions.decision: Phase 3 hallucination (CloseObject(Oven)) fixed purely via prompt rules, NOT fallback code
decisions.rationale: User explicitly rejected the fallback approach. The prompt must teach the model that collision entities are non-interactable.

decisions.decision: Executor stuck escape: MoveBack minimum increased from 4 to 8 steps (0.5m -> 1.0m)
decisions.rationale: 0.5m was insufficient to clear counter/cabinet geometry. 1.0m escape then rotate-only (no re-approach in same sequence).
Strafe is riskier than forward movement in tight kitchens. MoveRight x8 was the primary cause of the dead_loop pattern.
